headline: US Lawmaker Proposes Trade Incentives to Prevent Conflict Between Ethiopia and Eritrea
summary: US Representative Jim Baird introduced two bills linking expanded trade incentives to progress toward peace between Ethiopia and Eritrea. The proposal aims to use economic cooperation to prevent escalating border conflict.
why: Trade arrangements under US preference programs like AGOA affect economic growth and maritime logistics in the Horn of Africa.

impacts.name: Ethiopia
impacts.why: US legislation proposes tying duty-free commercial privileges to bilateral peace efforts with Eritrea.
